messages.subject: Announcing: New version of lavaan.survey (0.7)
parts:
Dear lavaan users,


For those of you interested in accounting for weights, clusters, or strata in your data, a new version of the lavaan.survey package (0.7) has been posted on CRAN today.

A set of example analyses is now available at

     http://wp.daob.org/software/

under lavaan.survey.

Please note that it may be a few days before the change propagates to all CRAN mirrors and the Windows binaries are compiled.

Best regards,
Daniel


New in this version:
    - WLS, DWLS estimator for complex surveys (similar to the standard estimator for linear regression with complex samples). Requires the development version of lavaan (0.5-12 of 2012-02-07 or later, as usual this is available as install.packages("lavaan", repos="http://www.da.ugent.be", type="source") ).
    - WLS estimation with the Yuan-Bentler smoother for the Gamma matrix (gives better results than WLS in some cases)
    - MLMV, MLMVS corrections from lavaan supported
    - New behavior when Gamma is not positive-definite: the estimation is still performed and afterwards a check is done to ensure the standard errors and test statistic are OK
    - Support for multiply imputed datasets (but take care when using weights as well - see documentation)
    - More/better comments in code
    - Example analyses up at: http://wp.daob.org/wp-content/uploads/2013/02/lavaan.survey-examples-paper.zip
